prompt:
A page from the manufacturability review a toolmaker sends back to a product designer before any steel is cut for the mould.

The part is turned about a vertical axis and is shown as a section through that axis, so the profile runs up the page. Its shape is given as seven stations, each 10 mm above the last, with the radius of the part at each station:
S1 12 mm, S2 18 mm, S3 26 mm, S4 21 mm, S5 30 mm, S6 24 mm, S7 15 mm.
Each station has its own label beside the profile on the drawing. The mould opens along that same vertical axis, one half lifting straight up and the other dropping straight down, and there are no side cores on this tool.

This page is the toolmaker's answer to the designer, so it carries the parting line as one bold line straight across the section at the station where the two halves have to meet, with that station's own label beside it, and it carries hatching over any band of the profile that cannot come out of its half when the tool opens, again with that band's station label beside the hatching. Which station takes the parting line, and which band is trapped, is the toolmaker's judgement -- I am deliberately not telling you either of them. No radius figure, no draft angle and no note is written on the part itself: apart from the seven station labels and the parting line label, the drawing carries no text. The station labels and the parting line are large enough to read.
easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show a section through a turned part with labels beside its profile? A review drawing, a technical drawing or a diagram all count as yes. Answer no only if the image instead shows a bare card stating an answer with none of that around it, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

steps.target: the bold line drawn straight across the section of the part

steps.read_crop: Copy the station label printed beside this bold line. Write the label only.

steps.target: a band of hatching drawn over part of the section

steps.read_crop: Copy the station label printed beside this hatched band. Write the label only.

steps.target: a station label printed beside the profile of the part

steps.read_crop: Does this cut-out show ONE station label, rather than part of one or more than one? Answer yes or no only.

steps.target: a radius figure, a draft angle or a note written on the part
